facts.fact: 软禁揭晓：客厅地板上排满 cubilia——她的 men 与 Seeker 号（Cadmar Sea Guard 的 Marked Match 猎人船！）的轮值卫兵共驻（Nash 批准）；Arms Master Korst 挡门（「Captain Artrayu ordered it」）——「My, how the tables have turned. I submit to wait for my keeper.」
facts.anchor: Arms Master Korst—assigned aboard the Seeker

facts.fact: Pyren 设定：火之力者=Pyren；「fire has been feared since the beginning of time—it kills」+「the Cadmarian Artrayus killed their Pyren King. You know this—you carry their name」——他的家族杀过持火之王；Draven 的判词：「you are the only woman with the power to burn the world for those you love, yet you are also the one who will never forgive yourself for the fire」
facts.anchor: And why the Cadmarian Artrayus killed their Pyren King.

facts.fact: 政治棋局：王国分裂（王后 grief 公开发声 vs Eirene 私下对抗）；Brant 成刺杀嫌疑（他的盔甲出现在袭击现场、落选后指控偏袒）但无法证实；「Percival cannot support you if it means he loses the kingdom's support」——她的流亡预案已成型（「Exile me…Don't strain your rule early on—I'm strong enough」「I always make contingencies」）
facts.anchor: Percival cannot support you if it means he loses the kingdom’s support.

facts.fact: Hayden 的滥用：Death Benefit 长期用于与 guard leaders 通讯——但收件人不自愿（受害者被杀取忆、家属永不知情）；「To take a beautiful gift and put it to his wicked use is another example of why we will never be at peace with Dranderon」「Hayden is a repulsive tyrant」
facts.anchor: he sends to unwilling recipients—like he did to me.

facts.fact: 船员规矩课：她吐槽 crew 刻板（Korst/Vantor/Leif）——「They will maintain appropriate boundaries with their captain's Marked Match」（警告口吻）——「It's a bit excessive for the captain's woman」自嘲 vs「You are so much more than the captain's woman」
facts.anchor: They will maintain appropriate boundaries with their captain’s Marked Match.

facts.fact: 蛇之问收束：他对峙逼近——「Do the snakes on your arm make you venomous, or is that just you?…Because if it's just you…I'd rather admire it.」；她的心率的失控（「he will hear it」）与拒绝先示弱；Pyren in the castle keep——试炼宾客全部离城
facts.anchor: Do the snakes on your arm make you venomous, or is that just you?
